title: fonoster.detector.v1
description: The Turn Detector interface (add-turn-taking, "Detectors are pluggable behind one interface") as a language-neutral contract, and the wire protocol for out-of-process Detectors over a local WebSocket. Inputs: caller audio frames, transcript segments with timings, agent output state. Outputs: a continuous end-of-thought estimate `eot` (0-1) with the facts `speaking` and `kind`. A Detector never emits turn events; AppBridge's Pacing policy does. Text frames are JSON messages below; binary frames from AppBridge are caller audio: exactly one 20 ms frame of PCM16LE mono 16 kHz (640 bytes), already through the app's audio filters. The Detector's clock is the frame count: frame n ends at n × 20 ms. The Detector answers every audio frame with one `estimate` carrying that frame number. AppBridge uses an estimate while it is at most 200 ms (10 frames) behind the audio it sent; otherwise it answers with its local baseline and records `detector.source` in the call record, so a slow or broken Detector never stalls a call. Budget: the estimate for a frame should arrive within 20 ms of the frame, so a remote Detector adds at most one frame to turn decisions and stays inside AppBridge's 50 ms (T1).

hello.description: appbridge → detector, first message on a new connection (one connection per session).

transcript.description: appbridge → detector: a transcript segment from the session's recognizer, at the current frame. `turn` carries a turn-aware recognizer's own signals (catalog feature turn-detection).

startMs.description: Segment start on the recognizer's audio clock

endMs.description: Segment end on the recognizer's audio clock

output.description: appbridge → detector: whether agent output is audible to the caller right now. Caller speech while it is true may be an interruption or a backchannel.

patience.description: appbridge → detector: a factor on the Detector's own timing (1 = as configured; 0.6 low, 1.6 high, raised further by within-call adaptation up to 1.6 times the app's level). Detectors without tunable timing may ignore it.

reset.description: appbridge → detector: the turn ended; forget it and start the next one from eot 0.

estimate.description: detector → appbridge: the estimate after audio frame `frame`. eot rises toward 1 as the caller completes a thought and falls when they resume; speaking says whether the caller is producing speech; kind classifies current caller speech: interruption only while output plays and the speech should take the floor, backchannel for acknowledgements ("uh-huh") that must not, none when silent.
